Name: ChooChoo — Command Forensics [1h]
Description: Deep-dive into commands issued against the train. Shows every MQTT publish and Modbus write with full payload and source context.

searches.query: tag=zeek grep "\"_path\":\"mqtt_publish\"" | grep "\"from_client\":true" | grep -v "\"id.orig_h\":\"172.18.0.7\"" | json "id.orig_h" topic payload | table "id.orig_h" topic payload
tag=zeek grep "\"_path\":\"mqtt_publish\"" | grep "\"from_client\":true" | grep -v "\"id.orig_h\":\"172.18.0.7\"" | grep "cmd/motor" | json "id.orig_h" payload | table "id.orig_h" payload

tiles.title: All MQTT Publishes from Clients — every message sent to the broker
Motor Commands Issued — topic=cmd/motor publishes with payloads
MQTT Command Rate — publish frequency per source on cmd topics
Topic Activity Timeline — messages per topic over time
Invalid Payloads — commands to cmd topics that are not valid JSON
Retained Messages — discovery beacons and persistent state topics
Modbus Write Commands — FC5/FC6 writes by source IP
All Modbus Transactions — full function code log
Modbus Write Rate — writes per minute per source (spikes = attack)
Modbus Read Rate — reads per minute per source (sustained = recon)
TRAIN STOPS — power:0 commands by IP
TRAIN STATE SUBSCRIBERS — non-infra IPs receiving state updates
MQTT Command Volume — cmd/ publishes this hour (gauge)
Modbus Write Volume — all WRITE function codes this hour (gauge)
Successful MQTT Commands — valid cmd/ publishes per IP over time
Successful Modbus Writes — WRITE function codes per IP over time
Modbus Exception Responses by IP
MQTT Connection Rate Over Time
MQTT Publish Rate by IP Over Time
🚨 DETECT — MQTT Cmd from Unauthorized IP
🚨 DETECT — Modbus Write from Unauthorized IP
